messages:
tyler: Heads up — sample-app started failing in Next edge after we cut SDK v1.3.0. Error in logs: `ReferenceError: process is not defined`

maria: oof. do you have the stack/logs? did anything else change in the build?

tyler: Only change I pulled was the exports map tweak in package.json (we removed `main/module` in favor of `exports`). Repro steps: clone sample-app, yarn, start `next dev --experimental-edge`, hit /api/chat -> runtime crash. Log: `at Object.<anonymous> (node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.js:12:5)`

ashwin: can you paste the package.json snippet? my guess: import/require targets are swapped or import points to cjs build. Edge needs ESM.

tyler: snippet:
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood-inference/sdk",
  "version": "1.3.0",
  "type": "commonjs",
  "main": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "./dist/esm/index.js",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
      "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
    }
  }
}
```

ashwin: yep, that's the bug. `import` is pointing at the CJS build — so bundlers/edge pick that and you get `process` references. Also `type: commonjs` forces Node style resolution. We should be shipping `import` -> esm, `require` -> cjs, and set `type: module` if we want default ESM.

maria: also TS resolvers sometimes look for a top-level `types` field, not only inside exports. Put `types` at root too to keep editors happy.

samir: fyi Next/Vite use the exports conditions in a specific order; if `import` maps to CJS you get runtime surprises. Quick workaround: set `exports": {".": {"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"},"./package.json":"./package.json"}` and ensure dist has .mjs/.cjs.

tyler: good call. For now I pinned sample-app to 1.2.9 to unbreak CI. Opening a fix PR to swap the mappings and add root `types`.

ci-bot: build failed — sample-app / e2e-edge (job 45) — see https://ci.internal/45 for logs (ff)

ashwin: when you patch, please add a tiny integration test that imports the SDK from an ESM-only environment (node --experimental-modules or a Next edge test). We should catch this before release.

tyler: will do. PR #1432 opened: fixes exports to point `import` -> `./dist/esm/index.js`, `require` -> `./dist/cjs/index.js`, adds root-level `types` and a changelog note. Also updated sample-app to explicitly pin to 1.3.1-rc for smoke test.

maria: nice. can you add a migration blurb in docs/upgrade.md — "if you hit process is not defined, pin to 1.2.x or upgrade to 1.3.1"?

tyler: added that in PR.

samir: plan: merge PR, cut patch v1.3.1, backport to `release/1.3.x`, then update sample-apps and the quickstart. Also run the edge smoke CI across Next and Vercel emulation.

tyler: merged and cut v1.3.1. verified sample-app edge CI passed on the PR branch and on the patched release. Rolling to release branch now. :tada:

maria: awesome. thanks for the quick turnaround. i'll follow up on docs and a short note in the 1.3.1 changelog.

tyler: closing the thread — if anyone still sees edge crashes ping me and I'll revert/change exports. :thumbsup:
